item.title: Rookie's shootout goal caps Golden Knights' rally against Maple Leafs
item.description: Trevor Connelly scored on a backhand shot in the fifth round of a shootout as the Vegas Golden Knights rallied from an early three-goal deficit to defeat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-3 on Thursday in Las Vegas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Trevor Connelly scored on a backhand shot in the fifth round of a shootout as the Vegas Golden Knights rallied from an early three-goal deficit to defeat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-3 on Thursday in Las Vegas. It was the first career shootout try for Connelly, a 20-year-old rookie. He faked a forehand shot and then pulled the puck back and wrapped the backhand shot around the left pad of Sergei Bobrovsky for the game-winner. Toronto's John Tavares then had a chance to force a sixth round in the shootout, but Adin Hill made a pad save on his wrist shot. The only other skaters who converted their shootout opportunities were Vegas' Braeden Bowman and Toronto's Kirill Marchenko, both in the first round. Jack Eichel scored on a penalty shot and also had an assist and Mark Stone and Brett Howden also scored in regulation for Vegas, which won its third straight game. Hill made 21 saves. Jack Roslovic, Easton Cowan and Nick Paul scored goals for Toronto, which was opening a three-game western road trip. Bobrovsky finished with a season-high 40 saves while falling to 0-2-1. Toronto jumped out to a 3-0 lead in the first 8:37 of the game. Roslovic, making his 600th career NHL appearance, started the scoring just 34 seconds into the contest when he squeaked a backhand shot from the right side of the crease over Hill's left pad and just inside the right post. It was his second goal of the season and his 300th career point. Cowan made it 2-0 with a breakaway goal, taking a stretch pass from Chris Tanev and beating Hill with a wrist shot on his blocker side at 3:20. Paul extended the lead to 3-0 when he deflected a one-timer by Darren Raddysh over Hill's left shoulder for his first goal with the Maple Leafs. Stone got Vegas on the scoreboard near the end of the opening period with his third goal, a slap shot from the top of the right circle off an Eichel drop pass. The Golden Knights dominated the second period, outshooting Toronto 21-8 while scoring twice to tie it 3-3. Howden got the first goal when Mitch Marner's crossing pass from the right circle deflected into the net off his skate at 1:12. Eichel, awarded a penalty shot when he was tripped driving the net by Morgan Rielly at 3:58, fired a wrist shot under Bobrovsky's glove from the slot for his third goal. It was his second successful penalty shot in four career tries. --Field Level Media

item.title: シンガポール中銀、追加引き締めへ 堅調な成長とインフレリスクで
item.description:
Xinghui Kok Jun Yuan Yong
[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - シンガポール金融管理局（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シンガポール中銀、追加引き締めへ　堅調な成長とインフレリスクで 14:34 配信

シンガポール金融管理局（ＭＡＳ）。２０１７年６月、シンガポールで撮影。REUTERS/Darren Whiteside

Xinghui Kok　Jun Yuan Yong

[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - シンガポール金融管理局（ＭＡＳ、中央銀行）は来週の政策決定会合で、金融政策を引き締めると予想されている。堅調な成長とインフレリスクを背景に、追加引き締めの論拠が強まっている。

ロイターが実施した調査では、アナリスト１０人全員が１４日の会合での政策引き締めを予想した。

ＭＡＳは７月、市場の予想に反して金融政策を引き締めた。シンガポールドル名目実効為替レート（ＳドルＮＥＥＲ）として知られる為替レートベースの政策バンドの実勢上昇率（傾き）をごくわずかに引き上げると表明した。政策バンドの幅と中心値の水準に変更はないとした。

４月にも政策を引き締めていた。

ＯＣＢＣのエコノミスト、セレーナ・リン氏は、中東紛争の拡大で粘着的な物価上昇圧力が財・サービス全般に広がる恐れがあり、コアインフレ率には上振れリスクがあると指摘。「スーパーエルニーニョ」の発生リスクも食品価格をさらに押し上げる可能性があると述べた。

バークレイズのエコノミスト、ブライアン・タン氏は「人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの圧倒的な規模」が２０２７年にかけて比較的堅調な国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の伸びを支える中、ＭＡＳが再び為替政策バンドの傾きを２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）という小幅な調整で引き上げると予想。

「ただ、経済成長から物価への波及はＭＡＳの想定より緩やかにとどまっているとみられ、中銀は今後もより積極的な引き締めを控えるだろう」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ベトナムの銀行の70億ドル増資計画、海外勢の出資拡大の好機に 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：北朝鮮が韓国と対立姿勢、米国にとって新たな悩みの種に 焦点：ＡＩ企業がシンガポールに相次ぎ拠点、米中対立の「中立地帯」に アングル：中国の飲食店がシンガポールに殺到、海外展開の足がかりに 最終更新: 10/9(金) 14:34 ロイター

item.title: US 10-year Treasury yield risks hitting 6% for first time since 2000, Pimco's Ivascyn tells FT
item.description: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield could rise to 6% for the first time since 2000 as high oil prices fuel inflation concerns and worries over the country's growing public debt, Dan Ivascyn, Chief Investment Officer at bond fund manager Pimco, told the Financial Times.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield could rise to 6% for the first time since 2000 as high oil prices fuel inflation concerns and worries over the country's growing public debt, Dan Ivascyn, Chief Investment Officer at bond fund manager Pimco, told the Financial Times. US Treasury yields are a yardstick for global borrowing costs and asset prices. The 10-year yield has [USN:L6N45T06X TEXT:"risen"] almost 120 basis points this year and is trading slightly below the 5.34% level it hit last week, its highest since 2002. A sharp rise from the current level of 5.29% was "feasible" in the near term, Ivascyn told FT on Friday, citing factors such as hedge funds unwinding their losing bond positions. "It is certainly possible, even from a short-term trading perspective, given that some of the activity we've seen in the last couple of weeks is tied to some negative technicals, some stop-out activity from the platform hedge funds and other levered investors. You can certainly get there," he said. If Treasury yields rose further, it could weigh on riskier assets such as stocks and corporate bonds, he said, adding that a move to 5.5% or higher would likely lead to "some decent weakness in risk markets, both credit and equity". Global bonds have come under heavy selling pressure this year as soaring energy costs fan inflation and the AI boom lifts economic growth, leaving investors positioning for an era where interest rates stay higher for longer. Bond yields, which rise when prices fall, have consequently soared globally, with the US 10-year Treasury yield posting its [USN:L1N45N05N TEXT:"biggest quarterly rise"] this century for the three months ending in September.

item.title: L'ouragan Isaias se renforce à l'approche des côtes américaines
item.description: L'ouragan Isaias s'est renforcé jeudi alors qu'il se dirigeait la côte des Etats-Unis dans le Golfe du Mexique, provoquant des évacuations et la déclaration de l'état d'urgence en Floride et dans l'Alabama alors que les météorologues ont mis en garde contre de dangereuses ondes de tempêtes, des tornades et des inondations.
item.dc:creator: Brad Brooks
item.content:encoded: L'ouragan Isaias s'est renforcé jeudi alors qu'il se dirigeait la côte des Etats-Unis dans le Golfe du Mexique, provoquant des évacuations et la déclaration de l'état d'urgence en Floride et dans l'Alabama alors que les météorologues ont mis en garde contre de dangereuses ondes de tempêtes, des tornades et des inondations. Le premier ouragan de la saison, dont les vents atteignaient tôt jeudi 140 kilomètres/heure (km/h), devrait presque atteindre la catégorie 3 vendredi, avec des vents atteignant les 175 km/h. Isaias devrait atteindre la côte nord du Golfe du Mexique vendredi soir ou samedi matin. "Nous nous attendons à ce qu'Isaias soit un ouragan dangereux lorsqu'il touchera terre", a dit jeudi le directeur du Centre national des ouragans (NHC) des Etats-Unis, Michael Brennan. "Il faut aujourd'hui se préparer." Les compagnies pétrolières ont évacué leurs installations offshores du Golfe du Mexique et arrêté leurs opérations. Le NHC a émis des alertes ouragan dans les zones côtières du Mississippi, en Alabama et en Floride. Des alertes pour une tempête tropicale et des ondes de tempêtes ont également été émises dans le sud-est de la Louisiane. Des évacuations ont été ordonnées en Floride où l'état d'urgence a été déclaré dans 25 comtés plus tôt dans la semaine. Trois aéroports du comté d'Okaloosa devraient fermer jeudi soir. L'état d'urgence a été déclaré dans 40 comtés de l'Alabama, où des évacuations ont également été ordonnées. Selon les météorologues, l'onde de tempête pourrait atteindre de 1,5 à 2,1 mètres dans les zones les plus touchées, tandis que de 8 à 18 cm de précipitations sont attendus. Jeudi après-midi, l'ouragan se trouvait à près de 570 kilomètres au sud de l'embouchure du Mississippi et se déplaçait vers l'est-nord-est à une vitesse de 17km/h, a indiqué le NHC.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street en ordre dispersé avec la hausse des prix du pétrole
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé jeudi, seul le Dow Jones marquant une petite hausse, alors que les prix du pétrole ont bondi en raison d'attaques autour du détroit d'Ormuz et d'une baisse de la production américaine, alimentant les craintes sur l'inflation et la hausse des taux d'intérêt.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en ordre dispersé jeudi, seul le Dow Jones marquant une petite hausse, alors que les prix du pétrole ont bondi en raison d'attaques autour du détroit d'Ormuz et d'une baisse de la production américaine, alimentant les craintes sur l'inflation et la hausse des taux d'intérêt. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a gagné 0,10%, ou 51,77 points, à 51.231,64 points. Le S&P-500 (.SPX) , plus large, a perdu 36,41 points, soit 0,47%, à 7.765,36 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a reculé de son côté de 345,35 points (1,25%) à 27.193,34 points. Deux jours après avoir atteint un record de clôture, le Nasdaq a subi la plus forte perte, plombé par le repli de 3,4% du secteur des semiconducteurs après que le Financial Times a rapporté que les revenus annualisés d'OpenAI ont été inférieurs de 20 milliards de dollars au montant signalé au préalable. Le marché connaît "une sortie de route" dans la perspective de la saison des résultats trimestriels et avec "le conflit en Iran qui fait monter les prix du pétrole", a commenté Terry Sandven, stratégiste en chef chez US Bank Wealth Management, à Minneapolis dans le Minnesota. Une série d'attaques contre des pétroliers dans le détroit d'Ormuz et une baisse de production aux Etats-Unis causée par des ouragans ont contribué à une nouvelle flambée des prix du brut, le baril WTI prenant 3,6% et le Brent 4,1%. L'approvisionnement amoindri en pétrole depuis le début de la guerre en Iran en février dernier a fait grimper les prix du brut de plus de 60% cette année, alimentant les pressions inflationnistes et laissant entrevoir un resserrement monétaire. C'est dans ce contexte que la Réserve fédérale (Fed) a opéré en septembre sa première hausse des taux depuis juillet 2023. Si les marchés financiers s'attendent à ce que la banque centrale américaine laisse ses taux inchangés en octobre, ils misent à environ 69% sur l'hypothèse d'un relèvement des taux lors de la réunion de décembre, d'après FedWatch de CME. Les rendements des bons du Trésor américain ont progressé jeudi, atteignant des niveaux proches de leurs records, tandis que les obligations à courte échéance ont bondi. Parmi les secteurs majeurs du S&P-500, l'énergie (.SPNY) a connu la plus forte hausse du jour. Côté valeurs, à noter, PepsiCo (PEP.O) a pris 3,7% après avoir annoncé une réduction supplémentaire de ses coûts et revu à la baisse sa prévision de bénéfice annuel. Starbucks (SBUX.O) a cédé 0,4% à la suite d'informations de presse selon lesquelles le groupe envisage de racheter Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG.N) , dont le titre a bondi de 6,2%. Palantir (PLTR.O) a fini en hausse de 2,4% après que Goldman Sachs a revu sa recommandation à "acheter" contre "neutre". item.title: Soaring freight rates threaten Asia's appetite for US crude
item.description: Tanker freight rates soaring to record highs are putting US crude oil out of reach for Asian refiners, pushing them to seek alternatives from the Middle East and Latin America, according to multiple traders and shipbrokers who track those markets.
item.dc:creator: Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Tanker freight rates soaring to record highs are putting US crude oil out of reach for Asian refiners, pushing them to seek alternatives from the Middle East and Latin America, according to multiple traders and shipbrokers who track those markets. The cost of chartering a very large crude carrier (VLCC) to carry 2 million barrels of US oil from the Gulf of Mexico to China in November hit $80 million this week, according to data from shipbrokers Simpson, Spence & Young on LSEG. This means the economics of moving the oil on that route are no longer viable, closing the so-called arbitrage window for the trade, the traders and shipbrokers, who spoke on condition of anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to the media, said this week. Instead, Asian refiners are considering switching to Murban crude from the United Arab Emirates, causing the grade's premium to [USN:L1N45U0AH TEXT:"rebound"] to over $11 a barrel to Dubai quotes on Thursday. At $40 a barrel, versus $8.60 before the US-Israeli war on Iran began in February, the shipping costs are equal to nearly half of the current price of a West Texas Intermediate crude future contract , sharply raising costs for refiners in the top oil importing region while shipowners reap bumper profits. US oil sellers were expected to cut offers to compete globally while some trading firms were switching to smaller-sized tankers, according to three traders and a shipbroker. "This dizzying rise in freight rates translates to a higher delivery cost of crude into the Asian refineries," said June Goh, senior analyst at Sparta Commodities, adding that product cracks would need to remain elevated to keep the overall refining margin positive. Japanese refiner Cosmo Oil has provisionally chartered a VLCC for $81 million to load US oil on November 19-21, according to two traders and two shipping sources. But attempts by South Korean refiner SK Energy and Trafigura to book VLCCs for $76 million to $77 million were unsuccessful, according to one of those people, a shipbroker. SMALLER AFRAMAX Trafigura has chartered the Aframax tanker Torm Hilde — capable of carrying about 600,000 barrels — for $24 million to load US oil for Japan on November 1 while Vitol's fixture for Aframax tanker Riverside to load US oil for South Korea in early November for $27 million did not go through, the shipbroker said. Trafigura declined to comment while the other companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Steady demand for tankers on this route and expectations of the further release of US strategic petroleum reserves were supporting freight rates, said another of the sources, a shipping analyst. Sparta's Goh said VLCC freight rates on the US Gulf to Asia and on the Fujairah to East routes have spiked more than 300% since mid-August. "The reasons for such exorbitant increases in VLCC freight rates are the hugely inefficient ship-to-ship (STS) activities as a workaround to the Strait of Hormuz closure and increased Atlantic Basin arbitrage crudes into the Far East, leading to lower open tonnage available," she said. An oil analyst with a trading firm said Murban was about $2 a barrel cheaper than WTI crude on a delivered basis to Asia. Hence, Asian refiners may buy more Murban or other alternatives such as Medanito from Argentina, the traders said, although some of them may still pay up for US oil for supply security. "The diversification angle for crude supplies remains in play while the flow from the Strait of Hormuz can still be disrupted, which means even if the arbitrage looks shut, there will likely be more Atlantic crude flows into Asia," Sparta's Goh said.

item.title: SALON Les constructeurs chinois automobiles débarquent en masse à Paris
item.description: Un nombre record de 20 marques chinoises seront présentes au Mondial de l'Auto de Paris la semaine prochaine, soulignant la rapidité avec laquelle les constructeurs chinois se sont imposés comme une menace concurrentielle en Europe malgré la multiplication des barrières commerciales.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey, Giulio Piovaccari
item.content:encoded: Un nombre record de 20 marques chinoises seront présentes au Mondial de l'Auto de Paris la semaine prochaine, soulignant la rapidité avec laquelle les constructeurs chinois se sont imposés comme une menace concurrentielle en Europe malgré la multiplication des barrières commerciales. Le contingent chinois de cette année sera deux fois plus important que celui du dernier salon en 2024, avec des noms établis tels que BYD (002594.SZ) et Chery (9973.HK) , auxquels s'ajoutent de nouveaux venus comme Aito et Avatr. Le Mondial de l'Auto de Paris arrive à un moment charnière pour l'industrie automobile européenne. Les ventes des constructeurs européens en Chine ont chuté depuis la pandémie de COVID-19, tandis que les constructeurs automobiles chinois, largement exclus du marché américain et confrontés à une demande intérieure en berne, se tournent de plus en plus vers l'Europe. "Les Chinois disent : 'Nous devons tenter de dominer l'Europe car nous sommes impuissants aux États-Unis'", a déclaré Brad Kunz, associé du cabinet de conseil Grant Thornton Stax. "Si les États-Unis avaient autorisé les constructeurs automobiles chinois à s'y implanter, l'Europe ne serait pas un champ de bataille aussi intense." Les données de Schmidt Automotive Research montrent que les marques chinoises détenaient une part de marché de 10,7% en Europe au deuxième trimestre, contre 5,7% un an plus tôt. LES FABRICANTS EUROPÉENS JOUENT UN "DOUBLE JEU" La pression exercée par la concurrence chinoise, conjuguée à la faiblesse de la demande européenne, aux droits de douane américains et aux coûts de l'électrification, commence à peser sur les constructeurs automobiles européens. Volkswagen [USN:L6N44V1DK TEXT:"supprime des milliers d'emplois"] et envisage la fermeture d'usines pour réduire drastiquement ses coûts. Le segment du haut du gamme n'est pas épargné puisque BMW (BMWG.DE) supprime lui aussi des milliers de postes. Les marques chinoises ont représenté plus de 26% du marché des hybrides rechargeables en Europe occidentale au deuxième trimestre 2026, contre seulement 2,2% à la même période deux ans auparavant. L'industrie automobile européenne fait désormais pression pour l'imposition de droits de douane sur les véhicules hybrides rechargeables chinois. L'UE travaille de son côté sur une législation qui inclura des dispositions "Fabriqué en Europe"; exigeant des niveaux minimaux de composants locaux pour que les véhicules électriques puissent bénéficier de subventions importantes ou de contrats gouvernementaux. Tout en luttant contre leurs rivaux chinois pour conquérir des parts de marché, les constructeurs automobiles européens cherchent également à tirer profit de leur essor en leur vendant les capacités de leurs usines sous-utilisées et en exploitant leur technologie. Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , par exemple, s'est associé à [USN:L8N41X0DI TEXT:"Dongfeng,"] une entreprise publique chinoise (600006.SS) . "TOUJOURS FORTE ET TOUJOURS PRÊTE" L'un des lancements européens phares du salon, la renaissance de la Citroën 2CV par Stellantis, permettra de tester de nouvelles règles autorisant les constructeurs automobiles à réduire certaines fonctionnalités afin de proposer des véhicules électriques plus abordables. Parallèlement, des marques chinoises auparavant peu connues font leur apparition telles que Aito, marque haut de gamme appartenant au constructeur Seres Group (601127.SS) qui souhaite que les ventes à l'étranger représentent 20% de ses volumes totaux d'ici trois ans, contre moins de 1% actuellement, et prévoit de lancer quatre SUV électriques haut de gamme pour l'Europe à Paris. François Roudier, secrétaire général de l'Organisation internationale des constructeurs automobiles, a déclaré que l'arrivée des marques chinoises avait contribué à redynamiser les salons automobiles après que l'intérêt de certains constructeurs traditionnels se soit estompé.

item.title: Schröder a célébré l'anniversaire de Poutine en Russie
item.description: L'ancien chancelier allemand Gerhard Schröder a participé à la célébration du 74e anniversaire du président russe Vladimir Poutine, a indiqué jeudi le Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'ancien chancelier allemand Gerhard Schröder a participé à la célébration du 74e anniversaire du président russe Vladimir Poutine, a indiqué jeudi le Kremlin. Des photos publiées sur Telegram montraient Gerhard Schröder et Vladimir Poutine souriant largement et se serrant la main devant un poêle à l'ancienne et un samovar. "Vladimir Poutine a appris la veille, en regardant les informations matinales, que Gerhard Schröder se trouvait à Moscou, où il était venu pour le compte de la société Globus", a déclaré le Kremlin sur Telegram. "Le président a invité son vieil ami chez lui. Gerhard Schröder était aux côtés de Vladimir Poutine lorsque le chef de l'Etat a fêté son anniversaire hier." Gerhard Schröder, qui a occupé le poste de chancelier allemand de 1998 à 2005, a récemment rejoint le conseil de surveillance de la chaîne de supermarchés russe Hyperglobus.

item.title: Tata Consultancy's AI strategy has key-man risk
item.description: Chair Chandra stepped up to guide the $78 bln outsourcer through tech disruption. Now that he’s at the centre of the broader Indian conglomerate’s power struggle, concerns over his bandwidth will grow. The latest quarter’s modest growth reinforces the IT giant's underperformance.
item.dc:creator: Ujjaini Dutta
item.content:encoded: Few people know Tata Consultancy as well as N Chandrasekaran. He spent three decades at the $78 billion outsourcer, including eight years as CEO before becoming its chair and also taking charge of Tata Sons, the holding company of the wider Indian conglomerate. But with Chandra now at the centre of a power struggle at the salt-to-steel group, concerns over his bandwidth to steer the IT giant through AI disruption will surface. The company's latest quarterly earnings on Thursday underscore the problem. Revenue for the three months to the end of September grew to about 732 billion rupees ($7.6 billion), up just 2.8% in constant currency terms. Though its annualised AI services revenue jumped 19% to $3.1 billion from the preceding three months, it accounts for just 10% of the top line. Tata Consultancy's (TCS.NS) deal pipeline at $9.6 billion was down 4% year-on-year. The net margin contracted 60 basis points to 19%. To shore up growth, Chandra has stepped up his direct involvement in recent months. That has coincided with a flurry of unusual deals. In August, Tata Consultancy acquired Porsche's (P911_p.DE) automotive and consulting unit. Last week, it took over US consumer electronics retailer Best Buy’s (BBY.N) global capability centre in India. The IT firm has also pivoted into capital-intensive investments by building data centres, with OpenAI as one of the customers. For Chandra to be a hands-on chair while the company confronts the AI challenge makes sense. He knows the company well, and Tata Consultancy is the conglomerate's cash engine, accounting for 89% of Tata Sons' profit for the 2026 financial year. Problem is, he is also chair at at least seven other group companies including Tata Steel (TISC.NS) , Tata Motors <TAMO.NS, (TATM.NS) , Tata Power (TTPW.NS) and Air India. With both the airline and the IT group in need of a big reset, Chandra already looked spread thin. Now he's locked in an all-out war with Noel Tata, chair of Tata Trusts, which owns 66% of Tata Sons. Not only does that limit the time Chandra has to focus on the operating companies but it also raises a question mark over how long he'll be around to try. Tata Consultancy investors appear to favour him staying: shares fell when his position looked most threatened by the trusts and rebounded after Chandra dug in his heels. Either way, it leaves K Krithivasan squarely with the job of seeing Tata Consultancy through the AI disruption and emerging from his predecessor's shadow. Since taking over as CEO in 2023, around the time the new tech cycle began disrupting IT services firms, Tata Consultancy's shares have lagged Infosys (INFY.NS) , HCLTech (HCLT.NS) and Wipro (WIPR.NS) . The shares rallied as much as 4% on Friday morning on faster AI revenue growth but that looks through a rather obvious key-man risk. Follow Ujjaini Dutta on LinkedIn and X . Tata Consultancy Services on October 8 reported revenue of 731.88 billion Indian rupees ($7.6 billion) in the quarter to the end of September 2026, up 11% year-on-year, or 2.8% in constant currency terms. item.title: Les Etats-Unis vont diffuser en direct l'exécution de l'auteur de la fusillade de Ford Hood
item.description: Les Etats-Unis vont diffuser en direct l'exécution de Nidal Hasan, qui avait tué 13 personnes sur la base militaire de Fort Hood au Texas en 2009, a déclaré un responsable du Pentagone.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les Etats-Unis vont diffuser en direct l'exécution de Nidal Hasan, qui avait tué 13 personnes sur la base militaire de Fort Hood au Texas en 2009, a déclaré un responsable du Pentagone. Nidal Hasan, un ancien psychiatre de l'armée de terre condamné à mort en 2013 par un tribunal militaire, doit être exécuté par peloton d'exécution le 3 décembre. L'armée américaine n'a pas eu recours au peloton d'exécution pour un condamné à mort depuis 1945, peu après la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Le responsable du département de la Défense a indiqué que des détails supplémentaires seraient fournis plus tard. Le secrétaire à la Défense, Pete Hegseth, avait déclaré plus tôt qu'il envisageait de rendre l'exécution de Nidal Hasan publique, selon des vidéos publiées jeudi sur les réseaux sociaux. "Nous ferons en sorte que les gens puissent la regarder, qu'elle soit publique, car les gens doivent comprendre que ce genre de choses a de graves conséquences", a dit Pete Hegseth. Nidal Hasan avait ouvert le feu dans un secteur de la base de Fort Hood où des soldats passaient des tests d'évaluation avant d'être envoyés en Irak ou en Afghanistan, et a déclaré à des psychiatres après son arrestation qu'il voulait devenir un martyr. Il a été reconnu coupable de 13 chefs de meurtre avec préméditation et de 32 autres de tentative de meurtre avec préméditation à l'issue de son procès en 2013 et condamné à mort. La dernière exécution d'un militaire en activité par l'armée américaine remonte à 1961.

item.title: Dax höher erwartet - Ölpreis geht etwas zurück
item.description: Der Dax wird am Freitag der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge höher in den Handel starten. Am Donnerstag hatte der deutsche Leitindex 1,2 Prozent tiefer bei 24.806,97 Punkten geschlossen. Für schlechte Stimmung an den Börsen sorgten erneute Turbulenzen am Öl- und Anleihemarkt. An der Wall Street rettete sich nur der Dow-Jones-Index minimal ins Plus. Beim Öl ließen die Versorgungsängste nach dem zuletzt deutlichen Preissprung etwas nach. Das Nordseeöl Brent und das US-Öl WTI verloren zum Wochenschluss jeweils rund eineinhalb Prozent auf 102,69 beziehungsweise 90,22 Dollar je Fass. US-Präsident Donald Trump schließt nach eigenen Worten eine erneute Offensive gegen den Iran vor den US-Kongresswahlen Anfang November aus. Zugleich erklärte er, man führe produktive Gespräche mit der Islamischen Republik.

Beim Öl ließen die Versorgungsängste nach dem zuletzt deutlichen Preissprung etwas nach. item.description: NEW YORK: US immigration agents shot and wounded a man on Thursday (Oct 8) in his car with a child present in the Marble Hill neighbourhood of New York City, according to the mayor, city police and eyewitnesses.Federal immigration agents have shot at least 21 people since Republican President Donald Trump ret

NEW YORK: US immigration agents shot and wounded a man on Thursday (Oct 8) in his car with a child present in the Marble Hill neighbourhood of New York City, according to the mayor, city police and eyewitnesses. Federal immigration agents have shot at least 21 people since Republican President Donald Trump returned to office, 7 fatally , sparking protests across the US. Critics contend that Trump's push to ramp up deportations has led to an increasing number of violent confrontations, and accuse the administration of resisting accountability for the agents involved. Trump has said many migrants must be deported, blaming them, often in sweeping terms, for financial fraud and violent crimes. "Early reports indicate agents surrounded (the man) and a 5-year-old child in his car before firing multiple rounds," New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said in a statement.

"I have been on the phone with President Trump and (Homeland Security) Secretary Mullin, negotiating the release of the man Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents shot. Those negotiations were unsuccessful," Mamdani said in a press conference late in the evening. He said he demanded from the Trump administration that ICE stop its enforcement actions in New York City. "These actions are making the city less safe," Mamdani said. "This city wants ICE out. We want ICE out of our city, ICE out of our schools, ICE out of our hospitals, ICE out of our streets, ICE away from our kids."

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani speaks during a press conference at the scene of a shooting reportedly involving US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers in the Bronx borough of New York City on Oct 8, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Eduardo Munoz)

The mayor said the child in the car is physically unharmed. New York Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch said NYPD has located the child with a family member after a wellness check. The Department of Homeland Security, ICE's parent agency, said in a statement ICE officers were conducting a "targeted enforcement operation" in the Bronx, New York, to arrest a man from the Dominican Republic with a prior criminal conviction. The man identified as 28-year-old, had been arrested twice in New York City in 2023 and 2025, according to NYPD Commissioner Tisch. "During the incident, an ICE officer discharged his weapon and the criminal illegal alien was injured," DHS said, adding that ICE officers rendered immediate aid. "The individual is alive and at a local hospital." The shooting occurred at around 4pm ET (2000 GMT), DHS said. Working at a restaurant near the shooting, Pedro Almarez said he heard shots fired and went outside to see several officers wearing ICE attire at the scene. "There were a lot of ICE officers, three or four cars," Almarez told Reuters by phone. He said NYPD officers arrived about 10 minutes later. He said the man was only removed from his car after an ambulance arrived. At the shooting scene, where police strung yellow crime-scene tape to cordon off a city block, a woman standing on a balcony overlooking the area told officers they were "taking our children", according to a Reuters witness.

item.title: 投資会社ＰＡＧ、中国恒大の子会社株式取得で独占交渉＝関係筋
item.description:
Kane Wu Scott Murdoch
[香港／シドニー ９日 ロイター] - アジアに重点を置く投資会社ＰＡＧは...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
投資会社ＰＡＧ、中国恒大の子会社株式取得で独占交渉＝関係筋 14:18 配信

中国恒大集団本社。２０２１年９月、中国広東省深圳市で撮影。REUTERS/Aly Song/File Photo

Kane Wu　Scott Murdoch

[香港／シドニー ９日 ロイター] - アジアに重点を置く投資会社ＰＡＧは、多額の負債を抱える中国の不動産開発業者、中国恒大集団の不動産サービス部門の過半株式を取得するため、独占的な交渉を行っている。関係筋２人が明らかにした。

恒大物業集団は９月３０日、親会社である中国恒大とＣＥＧホールディングス（ＢＶＩ）が、同社株式の売却を見据え、選定された買い手候補と独占交渉契約を締結したと発表。ただ、候補の名称は明らかにされていなかった。独占交渉期間は１０月２７日に終了する。

中国恒大の清算人は１年前、同社に対し、恒大物業の株式５１．０１６％の売却を検討していることを伝えていた。

ＰＡＧによる買収提案の金銭的条件については明らかになっていない。

中国恒大および恒大物業はロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。ＰＡＧはコメントを控えた。

ブルームバーグがＰＡＧによる独占交渉権の取得を最初に報じた。

item.title: India withdraws bank tax benefit on gold, silver, platinum imports
item.description: The Indian government did not extend a tax benefit for banks on imports of gold and other precious metals and they have been paying a 3% integrated goods and services tax since April, local media reported on Friday, citing the revenue secretary.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indian government did not extend a tax benefit for banks on imports of gold and other precious metals and they have been paying a 3% integrated goods and services tax since April, local media reported on Friday, citing the revenue secretary. The government informed the Goods and Services Tax Council, a body of federal and state government officials, about the change on Thursday, Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava was quoted as saying by the Moneycontrol website. "This is done to ensure parity of taxes imposed on imports of gold and other metals through different routes," Shrivastava said.

item.title: SpaceX fordert US-Mobilfunker heraus - Frenquenz-Kauf belastet T-Mobile US & Co
item.description: Das Raumfahrtunternehmen SpaceX mit sinem Satellitenbetreiber Starlink fordert die etablierten US-Mobilfunkanbieter wie T-Mobile US und Verizon heraus. SpaceX vereinbarte am Donnerstag den Kauf eines landesweiten Portfolios an Niederfrequenz-Spektren, um künftig Mobilfunkverbindungen direkt aus dem All auf Smartphones anzubieten. Verkäufer der 800-Megahertz-Frequenzen ist der Finanzinvestor Grain Management, der sein Portfolio vollständig abgibt. Finanzielle Details wurden nicht genannt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Das Raumfahrtunternehmen SpaceX (SPCX.O) mit sinem Satellitenbetreiber Starlink fordert die etablierten US-Mobilfunkanbieter wie T-Mobile US und Verizon heraus. SpaceX vereinbarte am Donnerstag den Kauf eines landesweiten Portfolios an Niederfrequenz-Spektren, um künftig Mobilfunkverbindungen direkt aus dem All auf Smartphones anzubieten. Verkäufer der 800-Megahertz-Frequenzen ist der Finanzinvestor Grain Management, der sein Portfolio vollständig abgibt. Finanzielle Details wurden nicht genannt. Mit dem Zukauf überwindet SpaceX des Unternehmers Elon Musk eine der größten technischen Hürden für satellitengestützte Mobilfunknetze. Die Niederfrequenzen können Hindernisse wie Wände oder Bäume besser durchdringen. Sie sollen das bestehende globale 2-Gigahertz-Spektrum von Starlink Mobile ergänzen, das für hohe Bandbreiten ausgelegt ist. Das Geschäft muss noch von der US-Kommunikationsbehörde FCC genehmigt werden. An der Börse sorgte der Vorstoß für Unruhe, da Investoren einen aggressiven Preiskampf auf dem ohnehin gesättigten US-Mobilfunkmarkt befürchten. Aktien von T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) , Verizon (VZ.N) und AT&T (T.N) fielen im nachbörslichen US-Handel um jeweils mehr als fünf Prozent. In dieser Woche hatte die Behörde FCC zudem den Antrag für die zweite Satelliten-Generation von Starlink Mobile genehmigt. Damit darf SpaceX 15.000 Satelliten ins All bringen, die weltweit für das 2-Gigahertz-Spektrum optimiert sind.

item.title: Record Chinese turnout puts European carmakers under pressure at Paris show
item.description: A record 20 Chinese car brands will descend on next week's Paris Motor Show, underscoring how rapidly China's automakers have established themselves as a competitive threat in Europe despite mounting trade barriers.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey, Giulio Piovaccari
item.content:encoded: A record 20 Chinese car brands will descend on next week's Paris Motor Show, underscoring how rapidly China's automakers have established themselves as a competitive threat in Europe despite mounting trade barriers. European carmakers will use the show to unveil new models and try to reassure investors they can compete, as Chinese rivals gain market share with a growing range of electric vehicles and hybrids. This year's Chinese contingent will be twice the size of the one at the last show in 2024, with established names such as BYD (002594.SZ) and Chery (9973.HK) joined by newcomers including Aito and Avatr. The Paris Motor Show comes at a pivotal moment for Europe's auto industry. Sales by European manufacturers in China have slumped since the COVID-19 pandemic, while Chinese automakers, largely shut out of the US and facing weaker [USN:L4N4490F1 TEXT:"demand"] at home, have increasingly turned their attention to Europe. "The Chinese are saying 'we've got to try and dominate Europe because we can't do anything in the US'," said Brad Kunz, a partner at consultancy Grant Thornton Stax. "If the US had allowed Chinese automakers in, Europe ... wouldn't be so much of a battleground." Data from Schmidt Automotive Research show Chinese brands held a 10.7% share of the European market in the second quarter, up from 5.7% a year earlier and above Japanese rivals who arrived in Europe in the 1970s. EUROPEAN CARMAKERS PLAY A 'DOUBLE GAME' Pressure from Chinese competition, alongside weak European demand, US tariffs and the costs of electrification, is starting to tell on European automakers. Volkswagen is [USN:L8N44W0B8 TEXT:"cutting thousands of jobs"] and considering factory closures to slash costs, while luxury rival BMW (BMWG.DE) is also shedding thousands of workers. The European Union imposed tariffs on Chinese-made fully electric cars two years ago, but Chinese automakers have responded by expanding into combustion-engine models and plug-in hybrids. Chinese brands accounted for more than 26% of the Western European plug-in hybrid market in the second quarter, up from just 2.2% in the same period two years earlier. Europe's auto industry is now pushing for [USN:L1N44I0MW TEXT:"tariffs on Chinese"] plug-in hybrids, while the EU is working on legislation that will include "Made in Europe" provisions requiring minimum local content levels for EVs to qualify for key subsidies or government contracts. While battling Chinese rivals for market share, European automakers are also seeking to benefit from their rise by selling them capacity at underutilised factories and tapping into their EV technology. Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , for example, has partnered with China's state-owned [USN:FWN41W0RF TEXT:"Dongfeng"] (600006.SS) . "The Europeans are playing a sort of double game," said Pedro Pacheco, vice president of research at Gartner. 'STILL STRONG AND STILL READY' Chinese automakers have emerged as formidable competitors in EV technology, but European manufacturers are seeking to fight back with a new generation of more affordable electric models. "This motor show will probably be the most important one in the region since the pandemic," said automotive analyst Felipe Munoz. "This is the platform the Europeans are using to tell the Chinese they're still strong and still ready." One of the headline European launches at the show, Stellantis' revival of the Citroen 2CV, will test new rules allowing carmakers to cut back on some features in order to offer more affordable EVs and counter Chinese competition. Meanwhile, previously little-known Chinese brands such as Aito, the premium marque owned by Chongqing-based carmaker Seres Group (601127.SS) , will be looking for a breakthrough. Aito wants overseas sales to account for 20% of total volumes within three years, up from less than 1% currently, and plans to launch four premium electric SUVs for Europe in Paris. Francois Roudier, secretary-general of the International Organisation of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers, said the arrival of Chinese brands had helped reinvigorate motor shows after interest from some traditional manufacturers waned. The large turnout in Paris reflects growing pressure on automakers on both sides to compete for buyers in an increasingly crowded market, he said. "For years people were buying cars, now manufacturers have to sell them," he said, adding that manufacturers who did not attend "have made a mistake". "It's no show, no sell in a way."

item.title: Wealthy French quit failing state schools squeezed by pensions and austerity
item.description: Clemence Remy moved to the French city of Nantes in 2020 and enrolled her two girls in the local state school. The teachers were good, but she grew so exasperated by rolling staff strikes that she eventually put them in a private school.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Stargardter, Leigh Thomas
item.content:encoded: Clemence Remy moved to the French city of Nantes in 2020 and enrolled her two girls in the local state school. The teachers were good, but she grew so exasperated by rolling staff strikes that she eventually put them in a private school. Those concerns about state schools have helped fuel some of France's most [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"violent protests"] in decades. They began last month at high schools in Paris' poor northern suburbs, where anger over teacher absences and shabby facilities quickly morphed into a nationwide movement against inequality, [USN:L1N45N0A3 TEXT:"weak public spending"] and falling standards. France's public schools have long been held up as a crucible of the republican ideal, a place where children from rich and poor families alike can receive a top-notch education imbued with the values of "liberty, equality and fraternity". But performance has been slipping for years, and the government is struggling to arrest the slide as gigantic pension outlays and a [USN:L8N45S1P0 TEXT:"need to rein in"] public finances leave little room for manoeuvre. Those issues have prompted a growing number of wealthier parents to abandon the public sector in favour of private schooling. Remy said the strikes at her daughters' school in Nantes, a left-leaning city in western France, were often last-minute, requiring repeated time off work with little notice. "School is an institution we should be able to rely on," she said. "In the end, you realise you can't rely on the system." STANDARDS FALL AS PENSIONS GOBBLE UP SHRINKING FUNDS The maths and reading levels of French 15-year-olds have fallen drastically since 2003, reaching a record low well below the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development average, according to the body's 2025 "PISA" results. French state secondary schools were unable to staff nearly 10% of teaching hours - or almost half a day of teaching per week - in the 2024/25 school year, of which three-quarters is due to the non-replacement of absent teachers. Between 10% and 20% of French school buildings are "in a significantly deteriorated condition", according to a 2025 report by Banque des Territoires, the investment arm of state-owned lender Caisse des Dépôts. The government's inability to turn the tide on education is partly explained by a growing pensions bill that sucks resources away from other priorities, experts say. France's 2027 education budget is €64 billion ($72 billion). Teachers' pensions add another 28% to the cost. Total government spending on pensions, which is due to reach 436 billion euros or 14% of economic output next year, has grown faster than all other categories of public expenditure over the last two decades, while spending has slipped for education, according to Reuters calculations based on Eurostat data. The steady growth in pension spending is due not only to an ageing population, but also to voters' resistance to increasing the retirement age or reducing what retirees get. Economist Erwann Tison of the think tank Institut de l’Entreprise said pension spending "cannibalises" the education budget. That means France can only pay early-career teachers below-OECD-average salaries that contribute to frustration and strike action. "France is effectively handing over large subsidies to older French at the expense of everyone else," Nobel-winning economist Paul Krugman wrote on his Substack on Thursday. "Mass national student demonstrations should come as no surprise." WEALTHIER FAMILIES MIGRATE TO PRIVATE SCHOOLS The vast majority of French private schools operate according to the "under-contract" model. Almost entirely Catholic-run, such schools have greater control over staffing and admissions. Their teachers are paid by the state, with fees covering non-teaching costs. A larger pool of substitute teachers means they are less affected by strikes or absences. Over 2 million children, or 17.6% of all pupils, attend one of France's more than 7,500 under-contract schools, according to a 2023 national audit office report. Although this proportion rose modestly between 2011 and 2021, the percentage of children from wealthier families has grown at the expense of poorer children, the report found. It said some families had moved over to avoid local state schools, or had concerns about safety and teacher absences. Pupils from "very advantaged" families accounted for 40.2% of the total in 2021 compared to just 26.4% in 2000, while over half of pupils at under-contract schools now come from "advantaged or very advantaged" backgrounds, compared with less than a third in state schools. "Fifty years ago, ambitious families aimed for the public sector," said Louis Chauvel, a sociologist at the University of Luxembourg. "Today, private institutions are often seen as the better route if you want to maximise your kids' chances." Virginie Durin, the president of Apel, France's main association representing parents of pupils in Catholic private schools, said not all were wealthy, and that many parents made great sacrifices to afford them. But she acknowledged a growing concentration of wealthier students in certain neighbourhoods. Nantes, where Remy lives, is a stronghold of under-contract schools in France, with 38% of pupils privately educated. Remy, who pays €191 ($214) a month per child, recognised that private schools were not affordable for everyone, and were at risk of being colonised by the wealthy. But she had no regrets. "I think it provides an environment where at least the children are encouraged to strive and do better." ($1 = 0.8920 euros)

item.title: Africa's biggest IPO exposes continent's cross-border investing barriers
item.description: The historic stock market debut of Nigeria's Dangote refinery was billed as an opportunity for investors across Africa to own a stake in the continent's largest refining complex and finance its own industrial development.
item.dc:creator: Duncan Miriri
item.content:encoded: The historic [USN:L1N456052 TEXT:"stock market debut"] of Nigeria's Dangote refinery was billed as an opportunity for investors across Africa to own a stake in the continent's largest refining complex and finance its own industrial development. But the $1.6 billion share sale was not registered as a public offering outside Nigeria, the prospectus showed, leaving investors relying on their own country's regulations or finding workarounds using the few eligible online financial platforms. The disconnect between Dangote's pan-African ambitions and the patchy take-up outside Nigeria shows how the continent's fragmented capital markets continue to constrain cross-border investment. The IPO was approved by Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission, which has no jurisdiction outside of Nigeria, pointing to the regulatory hurdles to a truly pan-African deal. Aliko Dangote, [USN:L1N45707J TEXT:"Africa's richest man"] and the majority owner of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals, told Reuters that dealing with multiple jurisdictions' securities rules was a "teething problem". The continent has pursued economic integration efforts, including the African Continental Free Trade Area, but lacks a framework for jointly regulating capital-market issuance. "I'm sure with this, a lot of our own capital markets will also try and change their regulations," Dangote said, to make it easier for cross-border investments in the future. "We want to make sure that the African capital markets collaborate with each other." BUILDING AFRICAN CAPITAL MARKETS Referring to a proposed refinery in Lamu, Kenya, Dangote said it should be listed on Nairobi's stock market and be accessible to investors across Africa and that, in turn, will help integrate the continent's capital markets. "That's what we want to do. We want to deepen them," Dangote told Reuters. There was strong demand for the shares across the continent, Dangote said, adding Kenya's and Botswana's capital markets alone could have fully subscribed the offering. An issuer gets regular feedback from advisers and brokers as an offering progresses. Kenya [USN:L1N45R0NF TEXT:"approved"] a public offering of Global Depositary Receipts linked to the IPO, the market regulator said, with just eight days left in the subscription period. Dangote has said he is aiming for 10 million shareholders in the refinery, double the retail subscribers [USN:L1N45S0LX TEXT:"attained"] by Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) in its blockbuster listing in 2019. 'EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED' Markets outside Nigeria wishing to participate in the IPO, such as the Nairobi Securities Exchange, had to seek regulatory approvals, which took weeks to secure. That left disappointed investors unable to subscribe and blaming disparate regulations for the missed opportunity. "People were extremely disappointed," said Kenyan financial researcher Sultan Mwangi, who had set aside $5,000 to invest. Africa's capital markets remain among the world's most fragmented, with regional integration, like boosting the local saving rate to increase investments, lagging efforts in Latin America and parts of Asia and investors still facing a patchwork of national rules and market infrastructure. In Rwanda, investors had to register with the market regulator before applying for shares, adding another hurdle. "Those eligible will be assisted by authorised intermediaries but registered in Nigeria," said Celestin Rwakumbuka, chief executive of the Rwanda Stock Exchange. The Dangote refinery offering demonstrates Africa's ability to finance industrial development, said Hannah Ryder of consultancy Development Re-imagined, as past large capital market deals focused on banks and telecoms. However, she said the IPO is "somewhat less ambitious in reality than it started off." "Most importantly and conceptually for the continent's manufacturing aspirations, it raises large domestic finance for an industrial asset, which is fairly unique for the continent," she said. The African Development Bank has been pushing a [USN:L6N421036 TEXT:"financing model"] called the New African Financial Architecture for Development, aimed at mobilising large-scale local savings after [USN:L8N40S19C TEXT:"aid cuts"]. With Africa's capital markets still shallow and illiquid, the IPO was expected to demonstrate how regional savings could be channelled into major investment projects. The AfDB did not respond to a request for comment. TWO INVESTMENT CHANNELS FOR AFRICA Only two brokerages, Ecobank and Standard Bank-owned SBG Securities, were listed in the prospectus as channels for African investors. Ecobank, which operates in 34 African countries, said it was seeing "encouraging interest... from investors across East, West and Central Africa." Standard Bank did not respond to a request for comment. By contrast, Nigerians can use 53 channels, including banks, brokerages and trading apps, to buy shares. Fintech firms say they can help widen access across borders. "One of the biggest opportunities fintech creates is the ability to remove geographical barriers to investing," said Richmond Bassey, chief executive of retail-focused fintech platform Bamboo. Bassey said Bamboo provides eligible Africans, including Nigerians outside the continent, access to the Dangote IPO through a licensed nominee in Nigeria. Dangote has promoted the sale as a way to spread share ownership among ordinary Africans. Investors can buy as few as 10 shares for 5,250 naira ($3.96). Lagos entrepreneur Jide Owolabi said he is investing despite what he perceived as steep valuation of nearly $50 billion for the refinery. "There is enough room for revenue growth as they begin to harness the potential from the petrochemicals and other value-added products, such as plastics and detergents," he said. Others were sceptical. "There are other companies that can offer better returns on investment," said Peter Oke, a financial literacy advocate in the southwestern city of Ibadan. ($1 = 1,325.3200 naira)

item.title: China's tax crackdown piles pressure on luxury brands as US spending falters
item.description: China's tax crackdown on wealthy individuals has become the latest headache for luxury brands, already grappling with the fallout from the Iran war and signs of slowing consumer spending in the United States.
item.dc:creator: Tassilo Hummel, Sophie Yu
item.content:encoded: China's tax crackdown on wealthy individuals has become the latest headache for luxury brands, already grappling with the fallout from the Iran war and signs of slowing consumer spending in the United States. The combination of challenges is likely to weigh on third-quarter results due from next week, reinforcing fears that the $350 billion luxury sector, mired in a three-year slowdown, may struggle to regain its former momentum. Shares in LVMH (LVMH.PA) and Birkin bag maker Hermes (HRMS.PA) are both down about 40% this year and trading near multi-year lows, while Gucci owner Kering (PRTP.PA) has fallen 29%, reflecting growing investor pessimism about the sector. Under Beijing's new tax rules, wealthy Chinese who used [USN:L4N44F0E8 TEXT:"offshore trusts"] to shelter assets have until October 22 to declare and pay years of back taxes, a move that threatens to curb spending in one of the industry's most important markets. Chinese consumers, who account for roughly a fifth of global luxury purchases, were long the driving force behind the sector's growth. Demand has weakened sharply, however, since the COVID pandemic. The 20% levy is hitting spending by ultra-high-net-worth individuals, a group that had until recently proved more resilient than middle-class consumers hurt by China's prolonged property downturn, said Alexis Bonhomme, head of Shanghai-based luxury consultancy Trinity Asia. "Until the deadline to pay the tax, some people may face liquidity issues", Bonhomme said. "This doesn't mean they won't start buying again, but right now, the mood just isn't there," he added. Summer shopping mall data in mainland China pointed to "a sharp deceleration in growth", Bernstein analysts said in a note. Two industry sources familiar with third-quarter mall trading in mainland China said overall conditions remained weak, although performance varied widely between brands. Smaller "quiet luxury" labels such as cashmere specialist Brunello Cuccinelli and LVMH's Loro Piana were outperforming more conspicuous brands such as Louis Vuitton and Gucci, they said. The concerns in China come as demand also shows signs of softening in the US, the luxury industry's largest market and, until recently, one of its brightest spots thanks to a tech-driven stock market rally. 'UNDERMINE CONFIDENCE FOR EVERYONE' US credit card spending on luxury goods, [USN:L8N45R16S TEXT:"tracked by Citi"], fell for a third consecutive month in September as broader consumer confidence weakened. The data followed surveys showing growing unease about the US economy ahead of the midterm elections. Kering has already [USN:L6N45O0FL TEXT:"warned analysts"] to expect a further contraction at Gucci, prompting a string of brokerages to cut their stock price targets. One of the few bright spots has been high-end jewellery. Brands such as Richemont's (CFR.S) Cartier have benefited as wealthy consumers increasingly favour gold and other precious materials, which are viewed as offering more enduring value. In downtown Beijing, Deng Qi, a 51-year-old exporter of ceramic building components, forecast 20% less spending on luxury goods than in previous years. The offshore tax measure, he said, had sent a clear message. "I don't think wealthy people who are subject to taxes on offshore trusts would stop buying luxury, they are not short of that few tens of thousands of yuan," he said. "The real issue is the broader impact, measures like that undermine confidence for everyone. Sooner or later they will set their eyes on the relatively rich." Investors will get their first read on the sector next week when LVMH reports results on Monday. Analysts expect quarterly sales of €18.5 billion ($20.7 billion), up 1% from a year earlier. Kering and Hermes report on October 22. ($1 = 0.8933 euros)

item.title: Glencore sees electrification trend driving strong uptake for Australia listing
item.description: Glencore expects strong demand from investors seeking exposure to trend toward electrification when it lists in Australia next week, CEO Gary Nagle said on Friday, adding that a deeper local presence may yield business opportunities although it has no set buyout list.
item.dc:creator: Melanie Burton
item.content:encoded: Glencore expects strong demand from investors seeking exposure to trend toward electrification when it lists in Australia next week, CEO Gary Nagle said on Friday, adding that a deeper local presence may yield business opportunities although it has no set buyout list. The London-listed miner and trader has seen "very strong" interest from potential investors as well as existing ones limited by overseas mandate restrictions, Nagle told reporters ahead of its October 14 secondary listing on the Australian Securities Exchange. Nagle has said he believes the $88 billion company can achieve inclusion in Australia's benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index (.AXJO) within 12 months, but analysts see momentum behind the stock potentially propelling it into the top indexes in [USN:L8N44B03D TEXT:"half that time"]. Glencore's exposure to copper, a key material in the shift to electrification, makes it particularly attractive to investors. Analysts estimate that copper could account for 50% of Glencore's earnings in 2030 if its assets are developed on time, up from around 30% currently. It is also among the world's top thermal coal producers, which in previous years may have hindered uptake due to mandate restrictions, but Nagle said investors' views have changed. "The idea that thermal coal is going to disappear overnight seems to be a fallacy and everyone seems to recognise that," Nagle said, adding that recent energy crises have highlighted the importance of diverse energy supply. "The world is energy short: it needs power, it needs electricity and it needs to be able to conduct that electricity," he said. "So copper is good, and all sources of electricity production are good, including thermal coal." Glencore also offers Australian investors commodity trading exposure, in becoming only ASX-listed company that has a metals and energy trading business, which is another draw, Nagle said. That business has helped Glencore blow past profit expectations. It said last week it expects its 2026 marketing-adjusted operating profit to exceed [USN:L6N45O0H1 TEXT:"$5 billion"], well above its earlier long-term guidance range of $2.3 billion to $3.5 billion. The company's earnings from commodity trading have leaped as conflict in the Middle East creates constraints across global energy markets. As a way to mitigate rising geopolitical risks, commodity trading was one of the appeals of Glencore's business for Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) CEO Simon Trott, when the companies discussed a potential $240 billion tie-up earlier this year, which Rio Tinto ultimately [USN:L4N3Z11V1 TEXT:"rebuffed"]. Analysts and investors speculated that Glencore's decision to list in Australia could acclimatise investors who had not [USN:L8N400022 TEXT:"seen value"] in a deal for another approach. "The decision to list here had nothing to do with any sort of M&A activity or ideas that we have around deals," Nagle said. "Of course, if having a listed security here provides any additional optionality, it’s certainly of benefit."

item.title: Musalem (Fed): Weitere Zinserhöhungen gegen Inflation nötig
item.description: Die US-Notenbank Fed muss nach Einschätzung des regionalen Notenbankchefs von St. Louis, Alberto Musalem, die Zinsen weiter anheben, um die Inflation auf das Ziel von zwei Prozent zu drücken. "Um die Inflation zeitnah wieder auf den Zielwert zu bringen, ist eine weitere Straffung der Geldpolitik erforderlich", sagte Musalem am Donnerstag auf einer Veranstaltung in New York. Wenn man von einem Zeitraum von etwa 18 Monaten ausgehe, deute dies auf Zinserhöhungen in den kommenden sechs bis neun Monaten hin. Mit Blick auf die nächste Zinssitzung der Fed Ende Oktober wollte sich Musalem, der in diesem Jahr nicht im Offenmarktausschuss (FOMC) stimmberechtigt ist, nicht festlegen. Er gehe unvoreingenommen in jede Sitzung und habe das Ergebnis nicht vorweggenommen, erklärte er.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die US-Notenbank Fed muss nach Einschätzung des regionalen Notenbankchefs von St. Louis, Alberto Musalem, die Zinsen weiter anheben, um die Inflation auf das Ziel von zwei Prozent zu drücken. "Um die Inflation zeitnah wieder auf den Zielwert zu bringen, ist eine weitere Straffung der Geldpolitik erforderlich", sagte Musalem am Donnerstag auf einer Veranstaltung in New York. Wenn man von einem Zeitraum von etwa 18 Monaten ausgehe, deute dies auf Zinserhöhungen in den kommenden sechs bis neun Monaten hin. Mit Blick auf die nächste Zinssitzung der Fed Ende Oktober wollte sich Musalem, der in diesem Jahr nicht im Offenmarktausschuss (FOMC) stimmberechtigt ist, nicht festlegen. Er gehe unvoreingenommen in jede Sitzung und habe das Ergebnis nicht vorweggenommen, erklärte er. An den Finanzmärkten wird weithin erwartet, dass die Notenbank den Leitzins im Oktober in der Spanne von 3,75 bis 4,00 Prozent belassen wird. Die Fed hatte die Zinsen zuletzt Mitte September angehoben. Für das Jahresende hatte sie dabei einen weiteren Zinsschritt nach oben signalisiert. Zuletzt hatten jedoch der New Yorker Fed-Chef John Williams und Fed-Vizechef Philip Jefferson erklärt, es gebe keine Eile, während die Notenbank neue Wirtschaftsdaten auswerte. Investoren rechnen nunmehr mit einer Zinserhöhung im Dezember. Musalem betonte zudem, dass die Finanzierungsbedingungen trotz des jüngsten Anstiegs der Anleiherenditen weiterhin das Wirtschaftswachstum stützten. Der Renditeanstieg sei kein Zeichen für einen Vertrauensverlust der Investoren in die Fed, sondern spiegele die Erwartung höherer Realzinsen in einer starken Wirtschaft wider. Getrieben werde dies zudem durch hohe Investitionen im Technologiesektor und den großen Finanzierungsbedarf des Staates. In diesem Zusammenhang warnte Musalem vor den hohen Schulden der US-Regierung. Diese befinde sich seit fast zwei Jahrzehnten auf einem nicht nachhaltigen finanzpolitischen Kurs. Es bestehe das Risiko, dass die hohe staatliche Kreditaufnahme der Wirtschaft schaden könnte.

item.title: ロシア西部で2人死亡、中部に無人機攻撃
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - ロシア西部ベルゴロド州がウクライナの攻撃を受け、２人が死亡し、４人が負傷した。ロシア国営タス通信が９日、地元当局者の話として伝えた。同州はウクライナと国境を接する。

ロシア中部カルーガ州でも無人機（ドローン）攻撃があり、９人が負傷した。

一方、ウクライナでは南部ザポリージャ市で、ロシア軍の爆撃により１人死亡し７人が負傷した。

item.title: Oxford lanza proyecciones sobre la inflación y tasas de Perú en el cierre de 2026
item.description: Perú es una de las economías de mejor desempeño en América Latina, pero su inflación lleva siete meses por encima del 3%, el techo del rango meta del banco central.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Salazar Castellanos
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — Oxford Economics prevé nuevas alzas de las tasas de interés en Perú y una inflación todavía elevada, ante los posibles efectos de un evento fuerte de El Niño y el impacto del conflicto en Medio Oriente sobre los precios de los combustibles. La proyección de Oxford es que la inflación cierre el año en 4,1% interanual, 0,1 puntos porcentuales por encima de la encuesta de los analistas del Banco Central de Reserva del Perú (BCRP). Esta dinámica se daría antes de regresar de forma sostenida al rango meta en el segundo trimestre de 2027, según las proyecciones de la consultora. Ver más: Comercio mundial sorprende al alza pese a los choques en Medio Oriente: estos países destacan en América Latina La inflación interanual en Lima subió hasta el 4,55% en septiembre en el acumulado de los últimos doce meses, según el Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI) de Perú. El jefe del INEI, Gaspar Morán Flores, atribuyó el resultado principalmente al aumento de los precios del transporte, impulsado por el alza de los combustibles y las tarifas de taxi, pese a la reducción de los pasajes aéreos nacionales. En septiembre, de los 586 productos que conforman la canasta familiar, 308 subieron de precio, 133 marcaron precios a la baja y 145 mantuvieron sus precios, de acuerdo con el reporte del INEI. Perú es una de las economías de mejor desempeño en América Latina, pero su inflación lleva siete meses por encima del 3%, el techo del rango meta del banco central. Ver más: Dólar en octubre de 2026: a cuánto llegaría en Colombia, México, Brasil, Argentina, Chile y Perú, según analistas El miércoles, el banco central mantuvo su tasa de interés de referencia en 4,25%, sorprendiendo a nueve de los 13 economistas encuestados por Bloomberg, que esperaban un aumento de un cuarto de punto. Solo cuatro habían previsto que no habría cambios. Los analistas de Oxford esperan que la Junta suba la tasa en 25 puntos básicos en noviembre, hasta el 4,5%, a medida que se materializan los riesgos al alza de la inflación. Estos incluyen precios de los combustibles más altos durante más tiempo en medio del conflicto en Irán y un fenómeno de El Niño intenso. “No descartamos uno o dos aumentos adicionales en el primer trimestre de 2027, dependiendo de si la inflación y las expectativas inflacionarias se mantienen elevadas”, según proyecta Oxford Economics. Oxford reseñó que la Junta mantuvo sin cambios su pronóstico de inflación y espera que esta regrese al rango objetivo el próximo año. Sin embargo, “creemos que la Junta está adoptando una postura más restrictiva, ya que las expectativas de inflación a 12 meses siguen ligeramente por encima del rango objetivo, en 3,1 %, y la actividad económica se mantuvo firme en el tercer trimestre. Por lo tanto, hemos elevado nuestra previsión de la tasa de política monetaria”, señalaron desde Oxford. Ver más: Perú sorprende y mantiene su tasa en 4,25% pese a inflación alta y riesgo de El Niño

item.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100 billion from Gulf investors for AI push, FT reports
item.description: SoftBank Group CEO Masayoshi Son is seeking to raise up to $100 billion from Gulf investors to fund a new wave of AI investments, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SoftBank Group (9984.T) CEO Masayoshi Son is seeking to raise up to $100 billion from Gulf investors to fund a new wave of AI investments, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. Son has held discussions in recent weeks with senior figures, including in the United Arab Emirates, about the potential fundraising, the report said. Reuters couldn't immediately verify the report. SoftBank did not respond to a request for comment. The move comes as Son ramps up AI bets, with the company announcing [USN:L4N45N1DV TEXT:"last week"] that it completed its $30 billion investment in OpenAI as part of its commitment to the ChatGPT maker's last fundraising round. SoftBank also raised $11.1 billion [USN:L6N45F1AU TEXT:"last month"] in the largest high-yield corporate bond sale globally to fund its mammoth bet on OpenAI. The Japanese investment conglomerate would use the proceeds to establish a fund that would acquire companies and improve their operations using AI and other advanced technologies, according to the report.

item.title: 「skyticket」に不正アクセス、1464万件情報流出か
item.description: [東京 ９日 ロイター] - オンライン旅行代理店のアドベンチャーは９日、同社が運営する比較予約サイト「skytick...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
「skyticket」に不正アクセス、1464万件情報流出か 13:44 配信

2017年5月13日撮影。REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - オンライン旅行代理店のアドベンチャーは９日、同社が運営する比較予約サイト「skyticket」のシステムが第三者による不正アクセスを受け、約１４６４万件の顧客情報が外部に流出したおそれがあると発表した。業績への影響は現在精査中としている。

不正アクセスは同社のサーバーと業務管理システム、バス予約サービスの予約情報でそれぞれ発生。このうち、１０月２─４日にはskyticketの一部管理機能を悪用して他のサーバーやクラウド上のデータに不正アクセスがあり、氏名、生年月日、メールアドレス、電話番号、住所、ハッシュ化されたログインパスワードなどの情報が流出した。９月２０日に起きた業務管理システムへの不正アクセスでは返金先の口座情報が流出した可能性があり、会員１人のアカウントへの不正ログインも確認している。

同社は不正アクセスの経路を遮断し、クレジットカード番号やパスポート情報の流出はないとしている。同社は顧客に対し、パスワードの変更などを呼びかけている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米ドル上昇、欧州の苦境がさらなる追い風に アングル：マクドナルド集団訴訟、ＡＩ活用の価格調整巡る訴え広がる 焦点：ブラジル大統領選、ボルソナロ氏勝利なら気候対策反故の懸念 コラム：米株高・金利上昇は併存可能、タームプレミアムの行方に不安も アングル：ＡＩ企業、臨床試験の成否をシミュレーションで予測 最終更新: 10/9(金) 13:44 ロイター

item.title: Morning Bid: Feeding the AI beast
item.description: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Ankur Banerjee
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Ankur Banerjee Investor angst over AI [USN:L1N45C04W TEXT:"bellwethers'"] seemingly insatiable appetite for [USN:L6N45N0Q6 TEXT:"capital"] to build the infrastructure necessary for the technology to start paying off has cast a shadow over markets, as worries about valuations and fears over profitability persist. A series of reports from different corners of the globe has sharpened the focus on the AI trade this week, weighing on technology stocks. [USN:L6N45U1FJ TEXT:"OpenAI"] has told investors its annualised revenue for September was almost $50 billion, a drop from what it signalled earlier, Reuters reported, while in Australia, data centre operator [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"Firmus"] shelved its $5 billion initial public offering, and said it would opt for a private fundraising round instead. Over in the US, another massive round of fundraising appears to be on the way, with [USN:L6N45S1CR TEXT:"SpaceX"] (SPCX.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) and Oracle (ORCL.N) all expected to raise billions to buy high-end AI chips. Morgan Stanley estimates that AI infrastructure will require $1.5 trillion in external financing by 2028, with [USN:L1N45G0W4 TEXT:"fundraising"] happening just as interest rates across the globe rise to combat the inflationary pressure from higher energy prices. That makes it more expensive to finance facilities whose returns may take years to materialise, while investors are also demanding greater visibility into the customers and cash flows that will support those investments. Meanwhile, public uneasiness with AI, and the small group of people who seemingly hold sway over it, has risen in recent months alongside concern that the technology could pose an [USN:L4N45T0O0 TEXT:"existential threat"] to humanity. Brent crude futures remain above $100 per barrel with the war in the Middle East showing no signs of easing, with bond yields still at elevated levels. A months-long global bond selloff has pushed borrowing costs to multi-decade highs, with much of the pain being felt in France. The pressure [USN:L8N45U1VY TEXT:"built"] on the country on Thursday as euro zone finance ministers and the European Central Bank told France to pass a 2027 budget to calm bond markets. Key developments that could influence markets on Friday: European Central Bank's Piero Cipollone and Isabel Schnabel speak, Brazil inflation (September), Canada employment (September)

item.title: 中国ＡＩツール「ＡＲＴＥＸ」が公開停止、韓国銀行攻撃受け
item.description:
Brenda Goh
[ソウル ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Brenda Goh

[ソウル ９日 ロイター] - 中国で開発された人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェントツール「ＡＲＴＥＸ」の開発者が８日、ソースコードを非公開化したと明らかにした。同ＡＩツールを巡っては、韓国の銀行を狙った最近の一連のサイバー攻撃で悪用されたと複数のセキュリティー企業が特定していた。

コード共有プラットフォームのＧｉｔＨｕｂ（ギットハブ）で「Ａｕｔｕｍｎ─２７」のアカウント名を持つ開発者が、「ツールの悪用を受け、ＡＲＴＥＸプロジェクトの更新を終了し、ソースコードを非公開にする。今後は新たなバージョンを一般公開せず、保守サポートも提供しない」と同サイトに投稿した。

ＡＲＴＥＸの本来の目的は、企業や組織によるリスク検証を支援し、セキュリティー能力を高めることだったと説明した。

韓国の銀行への攻撃にははっきり言及しなかったものの、ソフトウエアの違法な使用には一切反対し、法令違反行為について責任を負わないとした。ＡＲＴＥＸのギットハブページはすでに削除されている。

米サイバーセキュリティー企業クラウドストライクは７日、顧客の個人情報窃取を狙った韓国の銀行へのサイバー攻撃について、中国を拠点とする２６歳の人物が実行した可能性が高く、ＡＲＴＥＸとアンソロピックの「クロード・コード」を使用したとみられると明らかにした。

ＡＲＴＥＸはギットハブ上で今年公開されたオープンソースのＡＩエージェントで、侵入テストを自動化するために設計された。独立した大規模言語モデル（ＬＬＭ）ではなく、チャットＧＰＴやクロード、ディープシークなど外部のＬＬＭに接続し、組織によるネットワークの脆弱性検証を支援する。

韓国では９月下旬以降、少なくとも９行がサイバー攻撃の標的になったとされる。これを受け、警察は今週捜査を開始し、李在明大統領は強力な対応策を求めた。

中国外務省の毛寧報道官は８日の定例記者会見で、この事案について承知していないと述べ、中国は一貫してハッキング行為に反対し、取り締まっていると説明した。

item.title: エヌビディア出資の豪ファーマス、50億ドルＩＰＯ中止 需要低調で
item.description:
Scott Murdoch Christine Chen
[シドニー ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Scott Murdoch　Christine Chen

[シドニー ９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアが出資する豪データセンター運営会社ファーマスは、市場のボラティリティーや足元の市場環境を理由に、計画していた５０億ドル規模の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を見送り、代わりに未公開市場で資金を調達する方針を示した。

ファーマスのＩＰＯは実現すれば豪州史上２番目の規模となるはずだったが、投資家の需要は低調だった。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームが世界の市場を押し上げる中でも、投資家がＡＩ関連企業を選別していることを示す警戒シグナルとなった。

ファーマスは声明で「今後は未公開市場で資金調達を進めるとともに、公開・未公開市場での代替策を検討していく」と表明。ＩＰＯの条件は事業の強さと長期的な成長見通しを適切に反映していなかったと説明した。

「このため取締役会は、ＩＰＯを進めることは当社と株主の最善の利益にかなわないと判断した」とした。

同社は当初、１株当たり１１豪ドルで株式を売却する計画だった。この価格に基づく企業価値は３０６億ドルで、８月初めの資金調達ラウンドでの評価額１０５億ドルの約３倍に相当する。

ファーマスは、エヌビディアのほか、コーチュー・マネジメント、ブラックストーン、ジェーン・ストリートなどからも出資を受けている。独自のエネルギー・冷却技術を使い、モジュール式のＡＩファクトリーの設計・運営を手がける。

現在はメルボルンとシンガポールで、賃借するデータセンター２カ所が稼働しており、アジア太平洋地域にさらに５カ所を建設する計画だ。目論見書の草案では、５年以内にデータセンターから年間５０億ドルの利益を得るとしていた。

しかし、稼働中の施設が２カ所にとどまり、ＡＩデータセンターの建設実績もない中での評価額急上昇に、投資家は警戒感を抱いた。

item.title: Meta bans TikTok ads on its platforms in US, Japan and other countries
item.description: Meta's ban takes effect immediately in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Business

Meta bans TikTok ads on its platforms in US, Japan and other countries

Meta's ban takes effect immediately in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam.

File photo. The TikTok app icon on a smartphone in this illustration taken Oct 27, 2025. (Photo: Reuters/Dado Ruvic)

FAST

Facebook and Instagram-owner Meta has banned advertisements by ByteDance, the Chinese parent of TikTok, on its platforms in the United States and a handful of other countries, a company spokesperson said on Thursday (Oct 8). The move marks an escalation in the long-running rivalry between Meta and ByteDance, whose video-sharing app TikTok has emerged as one of Meta's most formidable competitors for user engagement, creators and advertising dollars. Meta's ban takes effect immediately in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam, and extends to third-party advertisers running campaigns that link to TikTok and other ByteDance properties in those countries, Meta said. "We don't have to run ads from a competitor whose goal is to pull people off our apps," Meta said. "Declining promotional services to a competitor is a normal business practice across industries. We will continue to compete on product quality and user experience."

TikTok and ByteDance did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment on Meta's move. TikTok's website shows that it does not support links that open or log users into other social media apps. However, users can still add links to their profiles that direct people to those platforms' websites. Meta has been urging TikTok and YouTube to follow steps it agreed to take on teen safety in August following a settlement of up to US$18 billion with US states over social media harms to children. Meta in August agreed to impose daily usage limits and restrict nighttime usage by children who use Facebook and Instagram, and enhance measures to prevent children from accessing age-restricted content. TikTok has not publicly commented on Meta's campaign, but it reached a settlement with Alabama in September that requires the social media platform to impose new usage limits and enhance age-verification measures for users in the state, resolving claims that it endangered children and misled consumers about its safety. TikTok operates in the US as a majority American-owned joint venture after a deal aimed at safeguarding US user data and averting a US ban on an app used by more than 200 million users in the country. Bloomberg News first reported Meta's ban earlier on Thursday.

Source: Reuters/aj

item.title: Eswatini king pledges to strengthen 'enduring friendship' with Taiwan
item.description: Eswatini's king pledged on Friday to strengthen his country's "enduring friendship" with Taiwan, during a return visit to Taipei after President Lai Ching-te's trip to the southern African nation in May that China tried to block.
item.dc:creator: Yi-Chin Lee, Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Eswatini's king pledged on Friday to strengthen his country's "enduring friendship" with Taiwan, during a return visit to Taipei after President Lai Ching-te's trip to the southern African nation in May that China tried to block. King Mswati III is set to attend Taiwan's national day celebrations on Saturday. The former Swaziland is one of just 12 small states, mostly in Latin America, the Caribbean and the Pacific, that have diplomatic relations with Taiwan. Maintaining ties with them is a priority for the government of the democratically ruled island, which China views as part of its own territory. In April, Taiwan accused China of pressuring three other African countries to block overflight permission for Lai's aircraft, causing him to [USN:L1N41502E TEXT:"postpone"] a plan to join celebrations of the 40th anniversary of the king's accession. Lai then made a [USN:L4N41G008 TEXT:"surprise trip"] in May, using an "arrive, then announce" approach more commonly followed by foreign leaders visiting war-torn countries, such as Ukraine. The monarch said Eswatini would continue to advocate for Taiwan's meaningful participation in the United Nations, to which it does not belong due to Beijing's objections. "We deeply value the enduring friendship and cooperation between our two countries, and we look forward to strengthening these bonds for the benefit of our peoples," the king told a welcome ceremony on Taipei's Liberty Square. Lai said the two sides had always collaborated from a position of trust and were partners who "support each other and grow together". China's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the king's Taiwan trip. April's incident was the first time a Taiwan president had cancelled an entire foreign trip due to denial of airspace access, an apparent new Chinese strategy to curb the island's international ties. The United States, European Union and Britain all expressed [USN:L1N4160C7 TEXT:"concern"] at the time. Lai's return flight to Taipei in May, on the king's private A-340, took a [USN:L1N41I00O TEXT:"route"] skirting airspace controlled by Mauritius and Madagascar, two of the nations Taiwan said were pressured by China to deny him airspace access. In May, China condemned Eswatini's leaders for being "[USN:L1N41J0FX TEXT:"kept and fed"]" by Taiwan.

item.title: 中国、10月の燃料輸出再開へ 連休中に一時停止＝関係筋
item.description:
Chen Aizhu Trixie Yap
[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Chen Aizhu　Trixie Yap

[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - 中国が大型連休中に一時停止していた１０月の石油製品輸出を再開する見込みだと、事情に詳しいトレーダー４人が９日明らかにした。世界的に逼迫している軽油、ガソリン、ジェット燃料の需給の緩和につながる見通しだ。

別の業界関係者２人によると、中国は１０月の軽油、ガソリン、ジェット燃料の輸出を合計で約３７０万トン承認した。

中国政府はイラン戦争で原油の供給や製油所の生産に混乱が生じたことを受け、国内の燃料供給を確保するため３月に燃料輸出の制限を開始したが、７月から９月にかけて規制を緩和していた。

通常は割当制度を通じて燃料輸出を管理しているが、最近は月単位で出荷を審査する形で監督を強化している。

中国国家発展改革委員会と商務省のコメントは得られていない。

中国の石油精製能力は世界最大だが、石油製品の輸出量はこれまでインドや韓国を下回ることが多かった。しかし供給の混乱を背景に、特にアジアで中国の石油製品への引き合いが強まっている。

ただ市場アナリストらは、中国の輸出再開による需給逼迫の緩和効果は小さいとみている。エナジー・アスペクツの石油市場アナリストのストゥティ・ジュンジュンワラ氏は「市場は全体として逼迫した状態が続き、中東からの供給も引き続き滞っているため、（効果は）限定的だろう」と語った。

スパルタ・コモディティーズのシニアアナリスト、ジューン・ゴー氏は、中国の輸出再開は予想通りだったものの、輸出量は想定を下回ったと述べた。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝村上1打点もＷソックス逆転負け、ガーディアンズが逆王手
item.description: ［８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［８日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は８日、ア・リーグの地区シリーズ（５回戦制）第４戦の１試合を行い、村上宗隆内野手が所属するホワイトソックスがガーディアンズに敗れて逆王手をかけられた。

２勝１敗でこの試合を迎えたホワイトソックスは、三回に村上の押し出し四球などで２点を先制。２─３と逆転された直後の五回には村上の安打などでチャンスを作り、押し出し死球と犠飛で４─３と再逆転した。

しかし六回にリリーフ陣がつかまり、集中打で一挙６失点。その後の反撃も及ばず、５─９で敗れて２勝２敗の五分に持ち込まれた。

「４番・一塁」で出場した村上は、３打数１安打、１打点、２四球、１盗塁、１三振だった。
